text: provider’s discovery document, <issuer>/.well-known/openid-configuration, gives URL JWKS jwks_uri. resolver fetches set , keeps ttl seconds, fetches early token names kid cached set , every min_refresh seconds, flood tokens made-kids turn flood requests. JWKS can list keys zujose use, Ed25519 keys; kept set skipped token name .
code: jwks_resolver <- function(issuer, ttl = 3600, min_refresh = 60) {   cache <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())    fetch <- function() {     config <- httr2::request(issuer) |>       httr2::req_url_path_append(".well-known", "openid-configuration") |>       httr2::req_perform() |>       httr2::resp_body_json()     if (!identical(config$issuer, issuer)) {       stop("The discovery document is for another issuer.")     }     jwks <- httr2::request(config$jwks_uri) |>       httr2::req_perform() |>       httr2::resp_body_string()     cache$keys <- as_jwk_set(jwks)     cache$fetched <- Sys.time()   }    has_kid <- function(kid) {     tryCatch(       {         cache$keys[[kid]]         TRUE       },       zujose_key_error = function(e) FALSE     )   }    function(header) {     age <- if (is.null(cache$fetched)) {       Inf     } else {       as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), cache$fetched, units = "secs"))     }     stale <- age > ttl     unknown <- !is.null(header$kid) && !is.null(cache$keys) &&       !has_kid(header$kid)     if (stale || (unknown && age > min_refresh)) {       fetch()     }     cache$keys   } } check <- jwt_decoder(   key = jwks_resolver("https://accounts.google.com"),   algorithms = "RS256",   issuer = "https://accounts.google.com",   audience = "my-client-id.apps.googleusercontent.com" )  claims <- check(id_token)
